peer_identity.arc_label: The Empress who appeals to Steelhead and is protected by Aghora—possibly Janus-Jana
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Rules the empire from the Golden Planet. Vulnerable without the Metabaron's protection—this dependency structures her relationship to the Castaka lineage. Appealed to Steelhead in exchange for his demand for the Supreme Metabaron title. In vol17 described as 'exhausted from battle and recent childbirth.' Target of assassination attempts.
peer_identity.rationale: These two records both describe a reigning Empress from the Golden Planet in the Steelhead–Aghora era. Vol11 Empress appeals to Steelhead for help against dimensional vampires; vol17 Empress is protected by Aghora and is under psychic assault. The timeline and role are consistent—both are the political sovereign seeking Metabaron protection. Likely the same individual (possibly Janus-Jana herself, though not confirmed). Merging is safe; contradictory facts would only arise if they were demonstrably different rulers.
